SHARED ENTRY RESTRICTIONS
Daily stop / restart lock / disabled family / blocked session → no new request. Session cutoff measured from broker-reported trade-session end; pre-close default 5 minutes.
SESSION_ALL_FLAT blocks R + PB; SESSION_PB_FLAT blocks PB; SESSION_BASELINE_CARRY disables these entry blocks. Direct BO uses reversal session gate.

disables these entry blocks. Direct BO uses reversal session gate.

div.div:
E1 • NORMAL_R_GEOMETRY • PB / direct BO / normal R
BUY: adjacent lower zone required.
SL = max(lower_zone.high, entry − InpRCapUSD); R0 = entry − SL > 0.
TP = low of FIRST upper zone with low − entry ≥ InpTargetR0Multiplier × R0.
SELL: adjacent upper zone required.
SL = min(upper_zone.low, entry + InpRCapUSD); R0 = SL − entry > 0.
TP = high of FIRST lower zone with entry − high ≥ multiplier × R0.
Normalize SL / TP to _Digits; recompute R0 from normalized SL.
Defaults: InpRCapUSD=$6.00; InpTargetR0Multiplier=1.0.

text.tspan: E1 • NORMAL_R_GEOMETRY • PB / direct BO / normal R
SL = max(lower_zone.high, entry − InpRCapUSD); R0 = entry − SL > 0.
TP = low of FIRST upper zone with low − entry ≥ InpTargetR0Multiplier × R0.
SL = min(upper_zone.low, entry + InpRCapUSD); R0 = SL − entry > 0.
TP = high of FIRST lower zone with entry − high ≥ multiplier × R0.
Normalize SL / TP to _Digits; recompute R0 from normalized SL.

E2 • HIGH_ZONE_REVERSAL_GEOMETRY
CalculateExperimentalHighReversalSLTP derives same adjacent-zone / capped base distance R_base > 0. Expanded R = InpHighReversalSLMultiplier × R_base (default 1.5). BUY SL = entry − expanded R; SELL SL = entry + expanded R. Require FIRST target at least target multiplier × expanded R away. Normalize levels; recompute R0. Expansion can exceed normal cap.

text.tspan: CalculateExperimentalHighReversalSLTP derives same adjacent-zone / capped base distance R_base >
0. Expanded R = InpHighReversalSLMultiplier × R_base (default 1.5). BUY SL = entry − expanded R;
SELL SL = entry + expanded R. Require FIRST target at least target multiplier × expanded R away.
Normalize levels; recompute R0. Expansion can exceed normal cap.

E3 • PORTFOLIO_RISK_SNAPSHOT
OFF → skip. Otherwise capital basis = initial account balance; QA discovery with positive InpQAStrategyCapitalBasis → QA basis.

Used = realized component + EA open cash risk + EA pending cash risk.
GROSS_DAILY = accumulated gross losses; NET_DAILY = max(0, −daily_realized_net).

Used = realized component + EA open cash risk + EA pending cash risk.
GROSS_DAILY = accumulated gross losses; NET_DAILY = max(0, −daily_realized_net).

div.div:
BUY / SELL / NO-TRADE CONTRACT
R-B / BO-B → Buy; R-S / BO-S → Sell. Requested Ask / Bid drives geometry / metadata; market price=0.0 lets MT5 choose execution price.
PB-B → BuyStop exactly at normalized broken-zone high; PB-S → SellStop at low; both GTC, never limit.
Fixed InpTestVolumeLot (source default 0.01); no automatic risk / margin resizing. Gate failure → no new request; PB follows D wait / expiry rules.
